address: 63 Runan Street, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: This is the place to go for quality dim sum and classic Cantonese fare at affordable prices. Under the experienced Chef Mak from Hong Kong, the menu has been slightly revamped. Rest assured that quintessential all-time favourites such as double-boiled soups, stir-fries and seafood dishes are still served. The signature char siu pork entices with its appetising colour, springy texture and robust flavours. Save room for the exquisite desserts....
